Preserve all FIVE horizontal and FIVE vertical continuous pure MAGENTA #ff00ff lines including outer frame at exactly their positions and width. No artwork crosses a line. Magenta reserved only for grid. No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no watermarks. Keep entire subjects and shadows in their cells; use cell space generously. Correct anatomy and specimen shapes. No harm, attacks, handling dangerous animals, or recognizable modern fictional character designs. Each element image is a conceptual explanation of substance/use/research, not an atom photograph. Exact order:
1. キュリウム: closed research sample holder beside generic historical laboratory glassware.
2. バークリウム: closed research sample holder beside laboratory building motif.
3. カリホルニウム: closed shielded neutron source holder beside detector.
4. アインスタイニウム: research target chamber and detector; no bulk specimen.
5. フェルミウム: research target chamber and detector; no bulk specimen.
6. メンデレビウム: research target chamber beside blank periodic grid motif.
7. ノーベリウム: research target chamber with tiny conceptual atom point.
8. ローレンシウム: particle accelerator target chamber; no visible bulk metal.
9. ラザホージウム: particle accelerator target chamber and tiny atom conceptual point.
10. ドブニウム: particle accelerator target chamber and tiny atom conceptual point.
11. シーボーギウム: particle accelerator target chamber and tiny atom conceptual point.
12. ボーリウム: particle accelerator target chamber and tiny atom conceptual point.
13. ハッシウム: particle accelerator target chamber and tiny atom conceptual point.
14. マイトネリウム: particle accelerator target chamber and tiny atom conceptual point.
15. ダームスタチウム: particle accelerator target chamber and tiny atom conceptual point.
16. レントゲニウム: particle accelerator target chamber and tiny atom conceptual point.
IMPORTANT: absolutely no magenta, pink or purple anywhere inside artwork, even iridescence, reflections or minerals. Blue-green is allowed. Magenta ONLY on divider lines.
